description:
**What you will be doing**
==========================



We are looking for an exceptional Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead the engineering build\-out of ML and agentic AI across our AML/KYC and Fraud platform. Our products use ML, LLMs and agentic systems to extract entities, risks and relationships from millions of structured and unstructured sources, to score customer, transaction and fraud risk, and to power our real\-time financial crime knowledge graph.



As a Principal MLE you will be a senior technical leader who builds the systems that bring our ML and agentic AI work to production. You will report into the VP of Engineering, working in alignment with the strategic direction set by the Director of Data Science, who owns AI/ML and data governance direction at ComplyAdvantage. Your remit is execution: the architectural design of our company\-wide MLOps and agentic AI platforms, the build\-out of new models and agent systems, and the engineering bar across all of it. You will also represent ComplyAdvantage at conferences and industry forums.



Your impact will shape how ComplyAdvantage uses ML across the company, and through that, how our customers detect money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions evasion and other financial crime. Your work will help evolve a financial crime knowledge graph that spans public and private data, and is helping our customers make financial crime a thing of the past.


**Scope of the role**
=====================


*Scope \& Key Responsabilities*


* *Architectural Leadership*: Lead the architectural design and implementation of our company\-wide MLOps and agentic AI platforms, covering training, evaluation, serving, feature/vector stores, and agent orchestration.
* *Strategic Execution*: Translate the ML and agentic AI roadmaps set by the Director of Data Science into scalable engineering deliverables, ensuring all production builds closely adhere to established data governance frameworks and compliance standards.
* *Engineering Rigor*: Set the engineering bar across the organization for code quality, rigorous evaluation design, operational standards, and CI/CD pipelines.
* *Advanced AI Implementation*: Lead the end\-to\-end engineering build\-out of AI systems pioneered and prototyped by Data Science, including LLMs, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), multi\-agent systems, and graph neural networks.


**Our Tech Stack:**


* Our technology stack is designed to run on public cloud architectures, notably AWS and GCP
* Development is organised around Kotlin and Python for our backend languages and TypeScript/ES6\+React for our frontend stack
* We make substantial use of relational database technologies, notably Postgres, Yugabyte
* We also use an event\-sourced model powered by Kafka for our communication bus and gRPC for our intra\-service communication protocol
* We use modern observability solutions from Grafana Cloud and deploy our code using ArgoCD


We have a strong emphasis on engineering excellence and strive to ship the best possible code and the best possible solutions to our customers


**About you**
=============



As a Principal Machine Learning Engineer with company\-wide impact, you will bring:


* Substantial experience building, training and productionising machine learning models at scale, including modern deep learning and large language model approaches.
* Deep production Python experience, strong software engineering fundamentals (design patterns, event\-driven architectures, observability), and an instinct for what makes a model and a system maintainable in the long run.
* Strong mathematical and statistical foundations. You can act as the company's go\-to expert on rigorous, defensible application of techniques.
* Experience leading the architectural design of MLOps platforms: training pipelines, feature and vector stores, serving infrastructure, and drift and performance monitoring.
* Experience with cloud (GCP and AWS), containerised infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, Argo Workflows), event brokers (Kafka) and modern data engineering workflows (batch, streaming, ETL).
* Experience turning a directing scientist's or product owner's brief into ML work that ships and delivers measurable value, and pushing back where feasibility, data quality or risk make stated goals unrealistic.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can engage senior stakeholders and engineers, and produce technical documentation people can act on.

 Over the past few years, the business has built an extensive vulnerability and threat intelligence dataset containing tens of millions of historical events, exploits, indicators, and threat actor insights.
 



 The next phase of growth is focused on predictive machine learning.
 



**The Opportunity** 




 Historically, cybersecurity platforms have largely been reactive, helping organisations understand what has already happened.
 



 This team is investing heavily in machine learning capabilities that can help predict what is likely to happen next.
 



 The goal is to build models capable of identifying emerging threats, prioritising vulnerabilities, detecting behavioural patterns, and helping customers make better security decisions before incidents occur.
 



 This is a genuine opportunity to shape the future direction of machine learning within a growing cybersecurity product and work with large\-scale real\-world datasets from day one.
 



**The Role** 




 You'll join a highly autonomous product engineering team and become the first dedicated Machine Learning Engineer focused on predictive intelligence.

 Responsibilities include:
 



 \* Predictive modelling and classification systems
   

 \* Anomaly detection and pattern analysis
   

 \* Training, evaluating and improving ML models
   

 \* Monitoring model performance, drift and reliability
   

 \* Production deployment and optimisation of ML systems
   

 \* Working with large\-scale vulnerability and threat datasets
   

 \* Collaborating with engineering, product and R\&D teams

 \* Model monitoring and drift management
   

 \* MLOps and deployment pipelines
   

 \* TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-learn or similar frameworks

 Experience within cybersecurity is advantageous but absolutely not essential.

title: ILI Field Specialist - US and Canada
description:
**Your Job**
DarkVision, a Koch Engineered Solutions company, is in search of a dedicated ILI Field Specialist to facilitate pipeline inspections across the United States and Canada. This role involves travelling extensively to maintain, test, and deploy Inline Inspection (ILI) tools. If you have hands\-on experience working with downhole or ILI systems, excellent communication skills, and the desire to work with rapidly evolving technologies, we want to hear from you. This is an excellent opportunity to join a world\-class team revolutionizing industrial imaging. The role will be based in our HQ in North Vancouver, BC, and will require 50 to 75% out of town travel.

**Our Team**


DarkVision's award winning Kraken is an ultrasound\-based ILI system that performs crack detection, geometry, and metal loss measurements all in a single run, at full line speed, and at ultra\-high resolution. The team at DarkVision empowers operators to make well\-informed decisions by providing them with a clear view of their piping infrastructure. Join us on this exciting journey as we strive to become the leader in industrial imaging.

**What You Will Do**  

  



* Field Operations: Prepare, operate, and troubleshoot ILI tools at various pipeline sites across the US and Canada. Oversee the deployment and recovery of the ILI vehicles.
* Maintain Equipment: Ensure that tools, parts, trucks, and critical equipment are checked, cleaned, calibrated, and verified for each job is an essential part of deploying the technology. You will have responsibilities relating to the care of the tools, outfitting of testing and support facilities, and tool planning and logistics between jobs.
* Troubleshooting: Deploying new technology naturally necessitates troubleshooting problems that arise in real\-time. You'll be supported by strong and responsive engineering and operations teams, but the ability to figure things out quickly, and improvise under pressure will be critical to overall job success. The capacity to anticipate and solve field problems is paramount.
* Collaboration on Product Testing: Work closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to help develop and follow processes to support testing of new ILI products. Your feedback from testing and field operations will contribute directly to product development.
* SOP Development and Documentation: Contribute to the development, creation, and organization of operating procedures, checklists, reports, and other program documentation.
* Communication: Quick, clear, and effective communication with customers, subcontractors, and DarkVision staff is your responsibility. Represent DarkVision with pride and uphold our reputation of excellent service quality.
* Everything \& Anything: There will be a wide assortment of standard and not\-so\-standard tasks that you'll be expected to complete, both inside and outside the typical field deployment umbrella. The role has an entrepreneurial side so that no task will be either above or beneath you.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

  



* Technical Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in engineering OR experience in either oilfield services or ILI.
* Ability to Travel: There is a significant amount of time away from home travelling and performing work in the field. Willingness to perform a high volume of fieldwork (50 to 75% of the time) sustainably is required.
* US and Canada Work Eligibility: The successful candidate must have existing legal work authorization for Canada and be eligible (through company support) for a US work visa (e.g. clean criminal record check and eligible for a TN visa as an engineer or a scientific technician/technologist)
* Drug and Alcohol Testing: Due to US Dept. of Transportation requirements, you must agree to ongoing drug and alcohol testing.
* Communication Skills: The ability to communicate problems, concerns, and discrepancies to stakeholders in a direct but diplomatic way is a crucial part of the role.

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

  



* Oil Field Service Experience: Hands\-on experience travelling, maintaining, and deploying integrity assessment technologies in the upstream or midstream sector.
* Certification: ASNT ILI\-PQ Tool Operator Level II certification or greater.
* Career\-Focused: If you're looking to work hard, advance your career, and get paid well while learning about ILI operations, you've come to the right place.
* Technology Enthusiast: DarkVision works on novel, innovative, and complex technologies. We also leverage all kinds of the latest tools and technologies across our business (we are, after all, a technology company that happens to be in the oil field service business). The desire to learn, play with and embrace new technologies and software systems is part of being a DarkVision employee.
* Experience maintaining and deploying electromechanical equipment.
* Experience with complex technical systems and inspection technologies.
* Experience working with engineering teams to introduce new technologies or processes.

**What's In It For You?**  

  



* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Growth Potential \& Career Advancement \- DarkVision is experiencing rapid growth with various new technologies, products, and markets. There are significant opportunities for increased responsibility, pay, and career advancement as the company continues to expand.
* Flexible work environment with extensive travel opportunities.
* Supportive team environment with a focus on safety and innovation.

**General Salary Range**


For this role, we anticipate paying $80,000 to $100,000 per year in base salary. This role is eligible for variable pay, such as job bonuses.


At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**


DarkVision Technologies Inc. is a Canada\-based tech company disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013\. We have created the world's most advanced acoustic\-based imaging platform. We are packaging it into multiple new product lines, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.


Backed by Koch Industries, one of the world's largest privately held companies, DarkVision's team of Mechanical, Skunkworks, Electrical, Software, and Machine Learning Engineers is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company's current and upcoming products.


Our employees work on cutting\-edge technologies that blend science with real\-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.


At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.


Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

**How to Apply**

If you have the above qualifications, we would like to hear from you. We thank all applicants in advance, but please be advised that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


We are an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation or assistance at any time during the application or selection processes, please submit a request by following the directions located in the FAQ section at the bottom of the kochcareers.com webpage.


Successful candidates will be required to complete a criminal background check.

**Your Job** 




 DarkVision is seeking a Machine Learning Scientist to join our Imaging \& AI team. You will research, design, and prototype the deep learning architectures that power our automated analysis tools. You will solve complex computer vision challenges to enable interpretation of industrial data at scale.
 



  





 DarkVision’s ultrasound imaging system collects huge datasets on the order of terabytes, detecting sub\-millimetric defects in industrial assets that span hundreds of kilometers. It is essential that we develop algorithms for the automated processing, classification, and visualization of this data. As a Machine Learning Scientist, you will focus on the mathematical and architectural challenges of interpreting this data, and creating models that learn efficient and generalizable representations for real\-world industrial applications.
 



  





 This role is on\-site at our North Vancouver, BC HQ, where employees enjoy a wide array of amenities including a fully equipped gym, squash court, steam room, climbing wall, and more!
 



  





**Our Team** 




 Working in the Imaging \& AI team, you will join a multidisciplinary group of scientists and engineers. This team is responsible for early\-stage ideation, research, experimentation, and development. You will collaborate closely with other technical members to ensure our models are integrated seamlessly into our products.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Applied Research \& Architecture Design: Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art deep learning architectures to solve large\-scale industrial problems. You will target tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, and anomaly detection.
* Model Prototyping: Rapidly prototype and validate new model concepts using Python and deep learning frameworks. You will own the experimental phase, ensuring models are statistically valid and effective before collaboration with engineering.
* Data Strategy: Work closely with Data Analysts and Data Scientists to explore and organize datasets. You will define the data extraction and preprocessing strategies required to train robust models.
* Performance Optimization: Continuously monitor model success metrics and research improvements to increase model robustness and accuracy on challenging, real\-world data
* Documentation \& Knowledge Transfer: Document model architectures, training details, and dataset procedures to ensure reproducibility, and facilitate smooth integration by the engineering team.



  





**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** 



* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; PhD preferred
* 3\+ years of experience developing or researching deep learning models
* Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, etc.
* Ability to design experiments and interpret complex results



  





**What Will Put You Ahead** 



* Experience processing medical or industrial ultrasound images
* Publications in top\-tier computer vision venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV)
* Experience with self\-supervised or unsupervised learning methodologies
* Hands\-on experience with ML lifecycle management tools like MLFlow, Amazon SageMaker, GPC Vertex AI, etc.
* Hands\-on experience with orchestration tools like Kubeflow, Prefect, Airflow, etc.
* Experience leading or mentoring other scientists or researchers
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, self\-driven environment
* Excellent communication skills to present research findings and write technical reports



  





**General Salary Range** 




 For this role, we anticipate paying $100,000 to $150,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.
 



  





*At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.* 




  





**Who We Are** 




 DarkVision Technologies Inc. is a Canada\-based tech company disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013\. We have created the world’s most advanced acoustic\-based imaging platform. We are packaging it into multiple new product lines, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.
 



  





 Backed by Koch Inc., one of the world’s largest privately held companies, DarkVision’s team of Mechanical, Skunkworks, Electrical, Software, and Machine Learning Engineers is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company’s current and upcoming products.
 



  





 We allow employees to work on cutting\-edge technologies that blend science with real\-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.

 We are seeking a talented and driven Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our team and take ownership of critical features across our growing ecosystem of applications.
 



  





 You will play a key role in building and scaling complex, multi\-tenant AI\-powered platforms – such as our current work in automated brand management and content governance. Your work will sit at the intersection of modern web development and AI, combining robust visual studios, AI workflows engineers, scalable APIs, and custom orchestration servers.

title: Intermediate Software Engineer-Internal Platform & AI Enablement
description:
**About Rhapsody:** 




 Healthcare is innovating fast and AI is accelerating the pace. But AI is only as good as the data it can securely access. Today, moving data between providers, payers, and digital health innovators is still harder than it should be, and inconsistent data quality creates risk, rework, and stalled initiatives.
 



  





 Our mission is to accelerate innovation by reducing the burden of data access and data quality so teams can build, deploy, and scale solutions with confidence. Rhapsody provides behind\-the\-scenes interoperability and data quality foundation that helps information move reliably between systems, across formats, and at the speed modern healthcare demands.
 



  





 Most people won’t ever see our products during a medical visit (that’s infrastructure). Think of Rhapsody as the connective tissue and increasingly, the “data readiness” layer that enables digital transformation, analytics, and AI initiatives by making data accessible, trustworthy, and actionable.
 



  





 At Rhapsody, we are an AI\-first company, meaning we actively use and embrace artificial intelligence to enhance how we work, collaborate, and deliver. We expect our team members to be open to adopting AI tools in their roles, continuously exploring ways to work smarter, improve efficiency, and drive innovation while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and ethical responsibility.
 



  





 If you want to help solve one of healthcare’s hardest problems, turning fragmented data into safe, usable information—apply at rhapsody.health.
 



  





**Candidate must be local to Auckland, NZ** 




  





**About the role** 




 We’re looking for a high\-performing software engineer to become the first dedicated member of our Internal Platform and AI Enablement function.
 



  





 This is a force\-multiplier role. Your job is not simply to ship code, but to improve the systems, workflows, and guardrails that allow every engineer to build, verify, ship, and support software more effectively. You’ll work closely with our existing Lead Engineers, who will help set direction and priorities in the early stages. Over time, we expect this role to grow in scope and autonomy, with a pathway into leading this function as it matures.
 



  





 This role exists to help turn AI from individual experimentation into organisational capability. As AI\-assisted and agentic software engineering becomes a standard part of how modern teams work, the real differentiator is no longer access to AI tools alone. It is the strength of the internal platform, the clarity of the engineering workflows, the quality of the internal context available to humans and tools, and the reliability of the feedback loops that sit around them. This role sits at the centre of that shift.
 



  





**Business outcomes this role is expected to influence** 




 Deliver better value to our customers, sooner, safer and happier by:
 


* Increasing engineering throughput without sacrificing quality or control
* Reducing friction in local development, CI/CD, testing, release, and production support
* Improving consistency and trust in AI\-assisted engineering workflows
* Reducing dependency on tribal knowledge by improving documentation, standards, templates, and self\-service workflows
* Strengthening the foundations for safe, measurable adoption of AI across software delivery
* Creating reusable platform capabilities that scale productivity gains across the whole engineering organisation



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Partner with Lead Engineers to shape the first wave of internal platform, developer experience, and AI enablement improvements.
* Build and improve the engineering “paved road,” including local development, CI/CD, test automation, release workflows, observability, service templates, internal tooling, and engineering documentation.
* Improve the day\-to\-day experience of building software, from setting up a local dev environment to debugging a production issue.
* Help shape the systems, repository conventions, documentation, and workflows that make AI\-assisted development more useful, reliable, and easier to govern in practice.
* Improve the quality and accessibility of internal engineering context so that both engineers and approved AI tools can work more effectively with company\-specific knowledge.
* Contribute to practical AI enablement initiatives such as workflow guidance, reusable patterns, lightweight evaluation and quality checks, and safe usage guardrails in the software delivery lifecycle.
* Identify recurring sources of developer friction and turn them into simple, scalable improvements that reduce cognitive load and improve engineering flow.
* Contribute across backend systems, tooling, automation, and infrastructure as needed. Lead by example in the use of AI\-assisted and agentic ways of working, using approved AI tools and agents as a normal part of how you analyse problems, design solutions, write code, generate tests, document systems, and automate repetitive tasks
* Help create consistent ways of working that improve reliability, maintainability, and developer confidence.
* Gather feedback from engineers, understand where time and energy are being lost, and turn that into high\-impact platform and DevEx improvements.
* Measure the impact of your work through practical indicators such as setup time, build times, CI stability, deployment confidence, onboarding speed, workflow adoption, and reduction in repeated friction points.



  





**What success looks like** 




 In your first few months, you’ll build trust across the engineering team, understand the highest\-friction developer journeys, and deliver a small number of visible improvements that make engineers’ lives easier. You’ll also quickly establish yourself as someone who uses AI and agents effectively in your own work, and who can translate that into practical, credible examples for others.
 



  





 Within 6 to 12 months, you’ll be a trusted owner of meaningful parts of the internal platform and DevEx roadmap. Engineers should feel the difference in faster feedback loops, clearer standards, more reliable tooling, and a more effective way of working with AI in day\-to\-day software delivery.
 



  





 Over time, you’ll grow from an engineer taking direction from existing leads into someone who helps lead this function technically and culturally.
 



  





**Who you are** 



* **Humble** 
 : low ego, open to feedback, and focused on team outcomes over personal credit.
* **Hungry** 
 : proactive, curious, eager to learn, and motivated by solving important problems.
* **Smart** 
 : strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, and a talent for simplifying complexity.
* **A servant leader** 
 : you naturally look for ways to unblock others, improve the system around them, and raise the effectiveness of the wider team.
* **A team player** 
 : collaborative, generous with context, and committed to shared success.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity** 
 : excited by the opportunity to help shape a new function rather than inherit a fully defined one.
* **Practical** 
 : you care about real\-world adoption and outcomes, not platform or AI for their own sake.



  





**What you bring** 



* Strong software engineering experience in production environments. This role is aimed at someone operating at the top end of intermediate level, typically with over 5 years of experience
 **,** 
 with the judgment and maturity to grow into a lead role over time.
* Solid coding ability in at least one modern programming language, and the ability to work across systems, tooling, and automation.
* Experience improving developer workflows, delivery systems, or internal tools, whether from a product engineering, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or DevEx background.
* Practical experience in some of the following areas: CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, observability, test automation, release engineering, service frameworks, or developer tooling.
* The ability to work closely with senior technical leaders, take direction well, and still show strong initiative and ownership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good taste in simplicity, maintainability, developer ergonomics, and operational quality.
* A genuine interest in helping teams use AI\-assisted development tools effectively, safely, and in ways that improve the overall engineering system.
* Leads AI\-first engineering by redesigning development workflows, orchestrating agent\-based tools, and building scalable automations integrated into core systems (e.g., CI/CD, testing, incident response).
* Drives team\-wide impact by setting standards, mentoring adoption, and delivering measurable gains in velocity, code quality, and reliability through advanced, multi\-agent execution.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
**We're building Cursor for RFPs.** 




  





 The way companies compete for work is being rebuilt, and Grizzly is building the platform at the centre of it.
 



  





 Governments in NZ and Australia spend over $150 billion a year awarding contracts through competitive bids. Add the private sector and that number multiplies. Every one of those contracts starts with companies responding to formal requests — RFPs, RFTs, RFQs, ROIs — and the process is painful: thousands of pages to understand, evidence to gather from across the business, and a polished response to compile, all under a hard deadline. For every winner, there are several others who spent hundreds of thousands of dollars on a response that was unsuccessful.
 



  





 Grizzly is building an AI\-first product that helps teams put their best foot forward in competitive bids, fast — combining a company's institutional knowledge with AI agents that analyse, draft, and refine bid responses within a single workspace.
 



  





 We're a privately funded, five\-person team based in Auckland. We've closed customers in the construction and engineering verticals, with strong traction in our pilots and no shortage of interest. We're moving fast, and looking for someone who wants to build with us.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on, AI\-heavy role. If AI, harness design, context engineering, and making agents work reliably in production sound like interesting areas, then this is your kind of role.
 



  





 As engineering lead, you'll own how Grizzly gets built \- the architecture, tooling, and technical direction behind the product. Most of your time will be spent in the codebase \- shipping features, designing systems, and working on the agent harness that our customers rely on.
 



  





 You'll report directly to the CEO and collaborate closely with our product lead to shape what gets built and how. This is a flat, high\-agency team. We value autonomy, collaboration, and impact over hierarchy or rigid role boundaries.
 



  





**In this role, you will:** 



* Own the technical side of the product end\-to\-end \- architecture, infrastructure, security, and the decisions behind them



  




* Evolve the agent harness \- what the model sees, when it sees it, and what it can act on



  




* Improve and extend the product \- new features, bug fixes, and keeping the codebase healthy as it grows



  




* Shape what gets built \- work closely with product to decide what's worth solving, how to approach it, and when it's good enough to ship



  




* Contribute to a culture of high ownership, low ego, and thoughtful collaboration.



  





**You might thrive in this role if you:** 



* Have 5\+ years of experience building and shipping software in production end\-to\-end



  




* Are comfortable across the full stack \- React, TypeScript, AWS or similar \- and can move across the full stack as needed



  




* Have an interest in AI, LLMs, and agent harness design (direct experience not required)



  




* Care about why you're building something, not just how \- and are comfortable with scope that's defined collaboratively



  




* Work well without a playbook \- you've operated in environments where the path forward wasn't obvious and found that energising



  




* Know the difference between code that needs to last and code that’s needed to learn \- and are comfortable writing both



  




* Bias toward trying things \- you'd rather test an idea quickly than debate whether it'll work



  




* Are a genuine collaborator \- you think out loud, raise concerns early, and commit when a decision is made



  




* Care deeply about customers and get energy from delivering something they love



  





**Bonus if you have:** 




 •  Experience at a 0\-to\-1 startup
 



  





 •  Hands\-on experience building AI\-driven products
 



  





 •  Familiarity with SST, NoSQL databases, Vercel AI SDK
 



  





 •  Experience with agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor
 



  





 •  Knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC2 or equivalent security frameworks
 



  





 •  Experience with RFPs, tenders, or competitive bid scenarios
 



  





**Why our team loves working at Grizzly** 




**Work that matters:** 
 The problem is real, the market is massive, and what you build will have a direct, visible impact on the people who use it.
 



  





**Real autonomy:** 
 You'll have the freedom to experiment, try new approaches, and shape how things are done, both in the product and how we work.
 



  





**AI\-first culture:** 
 We embrace new tools and push the boundaries of what they make possible \- it makes us faster, and what we learn feeds directly back into the product we build for customers.
 



  





**A friendly team** 
 that takes the work seriously but themselves lightly \- this isn't easy, and we wouldn't have it any other way. Good humour and strong relationships are what make hard work worth doing.
 



  





**Competitive compensation:** 
 This role has a range of $180k – $200k per year, with both your scope and compensation growing as Grizzly does
 



  





**Hybrid setup:** 
 three days in the office, two from home, with genuine flexibility when life happens
 



  





**Unlimited tokens** 
 for use with frontier models: As well as budget for any tool or resource that supports your work or learning.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Submit your CV and cover letter containing a few words on why you'd be a good fit. Bonus points if you tell us about something you've built that you're proud of \- and why.
 



  





 You don't need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could do great work here, we'd genuinely love to hear from you.

title: AI Architect - AI LAB
description:
**Description**
**Our purpose**
 Here at Datacom we connect people and technology in order to solve challenges, create opportunities and discover new possibilities for the communities we live in.
   

  

**The AI LAB**
 Our AI LAB will be focused on providing AI Products, Augmentation, and Agentic Accelerators to Datacom Business Units and our Customers. If you want to be part of a TEAM that will be working in AI Products day\-in and day\-out then The AI LAB will be where you want to be.
   

  

**About The Role (your Why)**
 The way we work and our customer needs are changing! We are going through a significant AI uplift that will be a real game changer in the ANZ Market. Our customers are loving our story and excited about our new service solutions.
   

  

 We are looking for a AI Architect to define and drive the technical vision for our AI\-powered solutions. In this role, you will be the key technical authority responsible for designing end\-to\-end AI architectures that are scalable, secure, and production\-ready. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution — translating complex requirements into robust architectural blueprints that leverage modern cloud platforms, large language models, and agentic AI patterns.
   

  

 Your deep software engineering background combined with hands\-on AI expertise will be critical. You will guide engineering teams, evaluate and select technologies, establish architectural standards, and ensure our AI solutions are built on solid foundations. You will join our Digital Engineering leadership team, working across multiple workstreams to shape the future of AI\-driven solutions at Datacom.
   

  

 We need exceptional architects who can think strategically and execute tactically — if you want to put an ANZ company on the global AI map, this is your moment!
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You will own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for AI\-powered solutions across multiple customer engagements, evaluating, selecting, and standardizing AI technologies, frameworks, and platforms for the organization.
   

  

 You will create reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for AI solution delivery; lead architectural reviews and provide technical governance across delivery teams; and collaborate with product owners, data scientists, and engineering leads to translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
   

  

 You will design data architectures that support AI workloads—ingestion, processing, storage, and retrieval—establish and champion engineering standards for AI quality, testing, security, and observability, and guide build\-vs\-buy decisions while managing vendor/partner technology relationships.
   

  

 You will mentor and uplift engineering teams in AI architecture and best practices, stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape to bring actionable insights to the organization, and present architectural visions and technical strategies to senior stakeholders and customers.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
**AI**
* Expertise in agentic AI and multi\-agent orchestration (tools, planning, reflection, chain\-of\-thought)
* Build AI evaluation frameworks with metrics, benchmarks, and QA for non\-deterministic systems
* Proficiency in prompt engineering, management, and security (injection prevention, guardrails)
* Ensure reliable model serving, GPU optimization, and cost\-aware inference


**Solution Architecture**
* Design end\-to\-end solutions across frontend, backend, data, and AI layers
* Create architectural decision records, reference architectures, and technical design documents
* Master distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and microservices
* Develop AI data architecture (modeling, pipelines, governance)
* Design API patterns (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) for robust AI service integration
* Address security with threat modeling, responsible AI, data privacy, and compliance


**Cloud Platforms \& Infra**
* Maintain expert\-level Azure/AWS/GCP cloud architectures
* Leverage AI managed services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI)
* Use serverless and container patterns (ECS/EKS, Cloud Run, Lambda)
* Build vector/search infrastructure (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, OpenSearch)
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, Pulumi) and GitOps
* Focus on AI FinOps and cost optimization


**Programming \& Technical Depth**
* Excel in Python for prototyping, review, and critical decisions
* Use TypeScript/JavaScript for full\-stack design
* Employ AI frameworks (Semantic Kernel, AgentCore, etc)
* Ensure AI observability—tracing, logging, monitoring, and drift detection


**Leadership \& Communication**
* Lead technical teams and mentor engineers
* Communicate complex concepts to non\-technical stakeholders
* Run architecture reviews, design workshops, and governance


**Why join us here at Datacom?**
 Datacom is one of Australia and New Zealand's largest suppliers of Information Technology professional services. We have managed to maintain a dynamic, agile, small business feel that is often diluted in larger organisations of our size. It's our people that give Datacom its unique culture and energy that you can feel from the moment you meet with us.
   

  

 We care about our people and provide a range of perks such as social events, chill\-out spaces, remote working, flexi\-hours and professional development courses to name a few. You'll have the opportunity to learn, develop your career, connect and bring your true self to work. You will be recognised and valued for your contributions and be able to do your work in a collegial, flat\-structured environment.
   

  

 We operate at the forefront of technology to help Australia and New Zealand's largest enterprise organisations explore possibilities and solve their greatest challenges, so you will never run out of interesting new challenges and opportunities.
   

  

 We want Datacom to be an inclusive and welcoming workplace for everyone and take pride in the steps we have taken and continue to take to make our environment fun and friendly, and our people feel supported.

title: Growth Engineer
description:
PURPOSE
   

  

 As a Growth Engineer at First Table, you will play a key role in building, testing, and iterating on customer\-facing experiences across both web and mobile platforms.
   

  

 This role sits within the Conversion \& Growth function and focuses on high\-cadence experimentation, conversion optimisation, onboarding improvements, and rapid validation of new ideas. You will work closely with the Conversion Lead to implement A/B tests, landing pages, funnel improvements, and customer experience enhancements across our website and mobile e\-commerce applications.
   

  

**Unlike Traditional Product Engineering Roles, This Position Prioritises**
* Speed of validation
* Experiment throughput
* Iterative improvement
* Customer behaviour insights
* Evaluating evidence and data


 You will work across both our Next.js website platform and React Native / Expo mobile applications, leveraging shared React and TypeScript knowledge across the stack.
   

  

 This role requires a high level of autonomy, pragmatism, and comfort working in fast\-moving environments where not every experiment becomes a permanent product feature.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and Engineering teams while remaining aligned with wider engineering standards, tooling, and development practices.
   

  

**Specific Duties \& Responsibilities**
 Conversion \& growth development
   

  

* Build and iterate on customer\-facing experiments across web and app platforms.
* Implement A/B tests, landing pages, onboarding flows, feature experiments, and conversion improvements.
* Rapidly prototype and validate new customer experiences with a focus on learning and iteration speed.
* Contribute to improving booking funnels, user journeys, and conversion performance across platforms.
* Optimise and refine experiments based on analytics, customer behaviour, and performance insights.
* Balance delivery speed with maintainable engineering practices.


 Web \& app engineering
   

  

* Develop and maintain customer\-facing functionality within:
+ Next.js web applications
+ React Native / Expo mobile applications

* Write clean, readable, and maintainable TypeScript and React code aligned with team standards.
* Work within shared GraphQL and API\-driven application architecture.
* Support implementation of responsive and performant UI experiences across devices.
* Contribute to frontend component reuse and shared patterns where appropriate.
* Assist with debugging and resolving issues across web and app platforms.


 Experimentation \& analytics
   

  

* Work with experimentation and feature flagging tooling to support rapid rollout and testing of features.
* Contribute to event tracking and analytics implementation to measure experiment outcomes.
* Help improve visibility into customer behaviour, conversion funnels, and feature performance.
* Support implementation of GrowthBook or similar experimentation platforms where applicable.
* Collaborate closely with Analytics and Product teams to validate hypotheses and measure success.


 Collaboration \& team contribution
   

  

* Work closely with the Conversion Lead to execute and iterate on growth initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product, Design, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver customer\-focused improvements.
* Participate in code reviews and maintain alignment with wider engineering conventions and standards.
* Communicate clearly about progress, blockers, risks, and experiment outcomes.
* Contribute to a collaborative, pragmatic, and delivery\-focused engineering culture.
* Be open to learning and adopting new tools, technologies, and experimentation workflows.


 AI enabled delivery
   

  

* Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, implementation, refactoring, test generation, documentation, and debugging, while remaining accountable for the final outcome.
* Break work into well\-scoped tasks that can be executed efficiently with AI assistance (clear acceptance criteria, constraints, edge cases).
* Apply “human approval checkpoints” before merge: validate correctness, performance, maintainability, and customer experience.
* Contribute to improving AI\-assisted experimentation and rapid delivery workflows within the engineering team.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Be punctual and work the hours and times specified.
* Prioritise workload to ensure work of the greatest importance to the business is undertaken with urgency and to a high standard.
* Support and help develop a positive workplace culture.
* Demonstrate excellent interpersonal communication skills.
* Responsibly manage all business resources within accountability levels.
* Undertake all duties and responsibilities outlined in this job description and all other
* duties as required by the business.
* Comply with all employment obligations.
* Promptly undertake to complete all reasonable and lawful instructions and directions given.
* Serve the business in good faith, promoting and protecting the business’s best interests.
* During work time, and such other times as may be reasonably required, dedicate all eﬀort to the execution and fulfilment of the duties, responsibilities, obligations, and instructions related to employment.
* Follow company guidelines for responsible AI use (no sensitive data leakage; protect First Table IP; use approved tools/workflows).
* Demonstrate through own actions a commitment to Health and Safety at work when undertaking work or observing others in the workplace.


**Required Experience**
 SKILLS, EXPERIENCE \& EDUCATION
   

  

* 2–5 years’ experience developing customer\-facing web or mobile applications.
* Professional experience with React and TypeScript.
* Experience working with modern frontend frameworks such as Next.js and/or React Native.
* Experience implementing responsive user interfaces and customer\-facing workflows.
* Experience working with APIs and GraphQL\-based systems.
* Experience working within collaborative Git\-based development workflows.
* Comfortable working in fast\-moving or iterative product environments.


 Valued experience
   

  

* Experience with React Native / Expo.
* Experience with experimentation or feature flagging platforms such as GrowthBook.
* Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimisation workflows.
* Agency or high\-cadence product experimentation experience.
* Experience with analytics and event tracking platforms.
* Understanding of performance optimisation and frontend best practices.
* Experience contributing to design systems or reusable frontend component libraries.


 Personal attributes
   

  

* Strong ownership mindset with a bias toward action and delivery.
* Comfortable working autonomously and driving work forward independently.
* Pragmatic problem solver who can balance speed and technical quality.
* Curious and experimentation\-oriented mindset.
* Clear communicator who can collaborate effectively across Product, Design, and Engineering.
* Comfortable working in environments with evolving requirements and rapid iteration cycles.
* Interest in customer behaviour, product optimisation, and measurable business outcomes.

* Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes)
* Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform

* Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance tuning of ML systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with healthcare data or regulated environments
* Familiarity with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems
* Experience with predictive modeling, natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs)
* Knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks and their applications
* Understanding of agile methodologies and DevOps lifecycle practices


**Core Competencies** 
* Production\-grade ML model deployment and lifecycle management
* Scalable infrastructure design for AI/ML workloads
* Cross\-functional collaboration and technical leadership
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Effective technical communication and documentation

title: Neuroscience, HCI & Cognitive Research Lead (All Gender)
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Neuroscience, HCI \& Cognitive Research Lead is a high\-level, senior individual


contributor (IC) role designed for an expert who bridges the gap between cognitive neuroscience,


quantitative Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and high\-density interface design.


Instead of managing people, you will lead the scientific and interaction strategy for the Doodle


product ecosystem. Your goal is to systematically decode how humans perceive time, experience


decision fatigue during group time coordination, and interact with automated time\-creation


systems. You will turn hard cognitive metrics into concrete design principles that our product


and UX teams can execute immediately.

### **What You’ll Actually Do**

**1\. Strategic Research Leadership**

* Establish and track **quantitative cognitive KPIs** to measure interaction quality across all core workflows.
* Embed behavioral evaluation frameworks directly into the quarterly product roadmap prioritization process.
* Identify and mitigate behavioral and cognitive risks in product feature specs before they reach engineering development.

**2\. Applied Neuroscience \& Cognitive Research**

* Design and execute rigorous experiments evaluating user attention allocation, interruption costs, and information processing limits.
* Conduct deep\-dive research into **temporal cognition**, which is how users psychologically process time, waiting periods, and availability synchronization.
* Translate neuro\-cognitive theories of habit formation and collective coordination into practical product loops.

**3\. HCI \& High\-Density Interface Design**

* Analyze and optimize complex, high\-density time coordination interfaces to minimize visual noise and cognitive friction.
* Develop clear, neuroscience\-informed guidelines for font hierarchy, information chunking, and layout structures that reduce user anxiety during high\-stakes availability matching.
* Evaluate the psychological boundaries of **Human\-AI interaction**, focusing on building appropriate user trust, transparency, and control in automated time\-creation flows.

**4\. Interaction \& Systems Thinking**

* Map holistic user attention flows across asynchronous digital ecosystems, looking beyond single\-page sessions to understand multi\-day coordination loops.
* Diagnose systemic cognitive bottlenecks in complex B2B group time\-creation journeys.
* Predict and measure the downstream psychological effects of notifications, alerts, and calendar interruptions on user focus.

**5\. Organizational Research Enablement**

* Run targeted workshops and continuous coaching sessions for Product Managers (PMs) and Product Designers to upgrade internal literacy in behavioral economics and HCI principles.
* Build a reusable, centralized repository of cognitive design patterns, validation checklists, and experimental frameworks.
* Scale evidence\-based product development by teaching teams how to run quick, statistically valid A/B behavioral checks.

**6\. Long\-Term Innovation Research**

* Craft early, visionary interaction prototypes utilizing AI tools to rapidly simulate underlying logic, test behavioral hypotheses, and represent complex systemic ideas.
* Anticipate the future of asynchronous alignment by exploring next\-generation paradigms: ambient computing, voice/natural language coordination, and zero\-UI predictive automation.
* Build foundational mental models for how users will collaborate as AI agents increasingly handle automated time creation on their behalf.

**7\. Product Strategy \& Business Impact**

* Align user cognitive comfort directly with core B2B business metrics, proving how reduced decision fatigue drives increased user retention, higher conversion rates, and lower churn.
* Synthesize complex academic and experimental data into crisp, highly commercial briefs for executive leadership to steer long\-term portfolio investments.

#### **High\-Complexity Technical Scopes**


To illustrate the expected depth of this role, you will architect and execute research initiatives addressing multi\-layered cognitive and behavioral friction points:

**Scenario A: Structural Complexity and Working Memory Constraints in Collective Alignment**

* **The Problem:** Multi\-party, multi\-layered time coordination inherently scales cognitive friction due to the high volume of asynchronous variables processed simultaneously. When interaction systems fail to account for biological limits on visual working memory, users experience rapid cognitive fatigue, stalling the time\-creation lifecycle.
* **Your Scope:** You will architect advanced, non\-invasive experimental protocols to evaluate how distinct information architecture patterns tax human processing capacity. Your role is to define the fundamental cognitive thresholds that govern complex data visualization in coordination systems, equipping our core design and engineering teams with the foundational interaction rules needed to prevent cognitive overload.

**Scenario B: Dynamic Calibration of Intent and Automation in AI\-Mediated Systems**

* **The Problem:** The shifting frontier of intelligent, predictive systems introduces a fundamental human\-machine friction point: balancing user intent with autonomous system execution. In structural time creation, poor calibration of this boundary triggers either hyper\-vigilant friction (due to low trust) or systemic errors (due to automation complacency).
* **Your Scope:** You will design systemic Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI) evaluation methodologies to study user agency across varying levels of automated coordination. By mapping how changes in interface responsiveness, information transparency, and state\-sharing affect user mental models, you will establish the baseline psychological criteria required for humans to seamlessly co\-operate with autonomous agents.

### **What do you bring?**

**Years of Experience \& Environments**

* **7 to 12\+ years** of post\-qualification experience as an applied researcher, product strategist, or interaction architect.
* Must have a proven track record operating within **fast\-paced commercial digital product companies** (SaaS, B2B/B2C productivity tools, collaboration platforms, or high\-velocity tech labs).
* *Note:* Purely academic profiles or individuals who have only worked in traditional UX agency settings will not have the required product exposure for this role.

**Technical \& Scientific Maturity**

* **Educational Depth:** Master’s or PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, Behavioral Economics, or Experimental/Computational Psychology.
* **Methodological Mastery:** Deep expertise in advanced experimental design, statistical analysis, quantitative usability testing, eye\-tracking methodologies, cognitive load testing, and longitudinal behavioral studies.
* **The Blueprint Balance:** You possess the scientific maturity to know when to demand strict academic rigor and when to optimize for rapid tech\-product velocity.

**Autonomy \& Product Exposure**

* **100% Autonomous Execution:** This is a senior IC role. You do not need a manager to scope your projects, build your test environments, or interpret your data. You own the cognitive research roadmap end\-to\-end.
* **Deep Design \& Product Fluency:** You speak the native language of product squads. You can effortlessly jump into a Figma file with a Principal Product Designer to critique layout density, sit with a PM to redefine a feature's conversion funnel, or sync with a Data Scientist on behavioral telemetry tracking.

**Expected Outcomes \& Measurable Metrics**


Success in this role will not be judged by the number of research papers written, but by the tangible improvement of our user experience and product metrics:

* **Product Performance:** Measurable reduction in user drop\-off rates and time\-to\-completion within high\-density time creation workflows.
* **Cognitive Efficiency:** Lowered subjective and objective cognitive friction indexes across core user journeys, verified through continuous panel testing.
* **Design Velocity:** Creation of a finalized, adopted "Doodle Cognitive Design Manual" used daily by product design teams to ship interfaces that respect human attention.
* **Strategic Moat:** Development of proprietary, defensible behavioral frameworks around how humans coordinate time, positioning Doodle as the definitive global thought leader in the evolution of interaction system design.

### **Why Doodle?**

* **Real Impact:** Your commits will change how the world meets.
* **Technical Stretch:** We deal with "Time" problems most companies never encounter. It’s a masterclass in distributed logic.


At Doodle, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual trust and respect, where equal employment opportunities (EEO) are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to age, race, color, disability, religion, gender, and sexual orientation. Diversity and inclusion are of utmost importance to us. We’re committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work and our products will be. We want to hear from you, so please don’t hesitate to apply!We look forward to receiving your full application.

**IMPORTANT NOTICE:** *Please note that we can only consider your application if you are* ***based and have the right to work in Germany.*** *At this time, we are unable to sponsor visa for this position or support with relocation.*

Wenn Du Modelle lieber im produktiven Einsatz siehst als in Notebooks optimierst, dann melde Dich gerne bei uns.

description:
**Role Overview**
 The Neuroscience, HCI \& Cognitive Research Lead is a high\-level, senior individual
   

  

 contributor (IC) role designed for an expert who bridges the gap between cognitive neuroscience,
   

  

 quantitative Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), and high\-density interface design.
   

  

 Instead of managing people, you will lead the scientific and interaction strategy for the Doodle
   

  

 product ecosystem. Your goal is to systematically decode how humans perceive time, experience
   

  

 decision fatigue during group time coordination, and interact with automated time\-creation
   

  

 systems. You will turn hard cognitive metrics into concrete design principles that our product
   

  

 and UX teams can execute immediately.
   

  

****What You’ll Actually Do****
**2\. Applied Neuroscience \& Cognitive Research** 
**3\. HCI \& High\-Density Interface Design** 
**4\. Interaction \& Systems Thinking** 
**5\. Organizational Research Enablement** 
**6\. Long\-Term Innovation Research** 
**7\. Product Strategy \& Business Impact**
* Strategic Research Leadership
* Establish and track quantitative cognitive KPIs to measure interaction quality across all core workflows.
* Embed behavioral evaluation frameworks directly into the quarterly product roadmap prioritization process.
* Identify and mitigate behavioral and cognitive risks in product feature specs before they reach engineering development.
* Design and execute rigorous experiments evaluating user attention allocation, interruption costs, and information processing limits.
* Conduct deep\-dive research into temporal cognition, which is how users psychologically process time, waiting periods, and availability synchronization.
* Translate neuro\-cognitive theories of habit formation and collective coordination into practical product loops.
* Analyze and optimize complex, high\-density time coordination interfaces to minimize visual noise and cognitive friction.
* Develop clear, neuroscience\-informed guidelines for font hierarchy, information chunking, and layout structures that reduce user anxiety during high\-stakes availability matching.
* Evaluate the psychological boundaries of Human\-AI interaction, focusing on building appropriate user trust, transparency, and control in automated time\-creation flows.
* Map holistic user attention flows across asynchronous digital ecosystems, looking beyond single\-page sessions to understand multi\-day coordination loops.
* Diagnose systemic cognitive bottlenecks in complex B2B group time\-creation journeys.
* Predict and measure the downstream psychological effects of notifications, alerts, and calendar interruptions on user focus.
* Run targeted workshops and continuous coaching sessions for Product Managers (PMs) and Product Designers to upgrade internal literacy in behavioral economics and HCI principles.
* Build a reusable, centralized repository of cognitive design patterns, validation checklists, and experimental frameworks.
* Scale evidence\-based product development by teaching teams how to run quick, statistically valid A/B behavioral checks.
* Craft early, visionary interaction prototypes utilizing AI tools to rapidly simulate underlying logic, test behavioral hypotheses, and represent complex systemic ideas.
* Anticipate the future of asynchronous alignment by exploring next\-generation paradigms: ambient computing, voice/natural language coordination, and zero\-UI predictive automation.
* Build foundational mental models for how users will collaborate as AI agents increasingly handle automated time creation on their behalf.
* Align user cognitive comfort directly with core B2B business metrics, proving how reduced decision fatigue drives increased user retention, higher conversion rates, and lower churn.
* Synthesize complex academic and experimental data into crisp, highly commercial briefs for executive leadership to steer long\-term portfolio investments.


****High\-Complexity Technical Scopes****
 To illustrate the expected depth of this role, you will architect and execute research initiatives addressing multi\-layered cognitive and behavioral friction points:
   

  

**Scenario A: Structural Complexity and Working Memory Constraints in Collective Alignment**
* The Problem: Multi\-party, multi\-layered time coordination inherently scales cognitive friction due to the high volume of asynchronous variables processed simultaneously. When interaction systems fail to account for biological limits on visual working memory, users experience rapid cognitive fatigue, stalling the time\-creation lifecycle.
* Your Scope: You will architect advanced, non\-invasive experimental protocols to evaluate how distinct information architecture patterns tax human processing capacity. Your role is to define the fundamental cognitive thresholds that govern complex data visualization in coordination systems, equipping our core design and engineering teams with the foundational interaction rules needed to prevent cognitive overload.


**Scenario B: Dynamic Calibration of Intent and Automation in AI\-Mediated Systems**
* The Problem: The shifting frontier of intelligent, predictive systems introduces a fundamental human\-machine friction point: balancing user intent with autonomous system execution. In structural time creation, poor calibration of this boundary triggers either hyper\-vigilant friction (due to low trust) or systemic errors (due to automation complacency).
* Your Scope: You will design systemic Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI) evaluation methodologies to study user agency across varying levels of automated coordination. By mapping how changes in interface responsiveness, information transparency, and state\-sharing affect user mental models, you will establish the baseline psychological criteria required for humans to seamlessly co\-operate with autonomous agents.


****What do you bring?****
**Years Of Experience \& Environments**
* 7 to 12\+ years of post\-qualification experience as an applied researcher, product strategist, or interaction architect.
* Must have a proven track record operating within fast\-paced commercial digital product companies (SaaS, B2B/B2C productivity tools, collaboration platforms, or high\-velocity tech labs).
* Note: Purely academic profiles or individuals who have only worked in traditional UX agency settings will not have the required product exposure for this role.


**Technical \& Scientific Maturity**
* Educational Depth: Master’s or PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience, Human\-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, Behavioral Economics, or Experimental/Computational Psychology.
* Methodological Mastery: Deep expertise in advanced experimental design, statistical analysis, quantitative usability testing, eye\-tracking methodologies, cognitive load testing, and longitudinal behavioral studies.
* The Blueprint Balance: You possess the scientific maturity to know when to demand strict academic rigor and when to optimize for rapid tech\-product velocity.


**Autonomy \& Product Exposure**
* 100% Autonomous Execution: This is a senior IC role. You do not need a manager to scope your projects, build your test environments, or interpret your data. You own the cognitive research roadmap end\-to\-end.
* Deep Design \& Product Fluency: You speak the native language of product squads. You can effortlessly jump into a Figma file with a Principal Product Designer to critique layout density, sit with a PM to redefine a feature's conversion funnel, or sync with a Data Scientist on behavioral telemetry tracking.


**Expected Outcomes \& Measurable Metrics**
 Success in this role will not be judged by the number of research papers written, but by the tangible improvement of our user experience and product metrics:
   

  

* Product Performance: Measurable reduction in user drop\-off rates and time\-to\-completion within high\-density time creation workflows.
* Cognitive Efficiency: Lowered subjective and objective cognitive friction indexes across core user journeys, verified through continuous panel testing.
* Design Velocity: Creation of a finalized, adopted "Doodle Cognitive Design Manual" used daily by product design teams to ship interfaces that respect human attention.
* Strategic Moat: Development of proprietary, defensible behavioral frameworks around how humans coordinate time, positioning Doodle as the definitive global thought leader in the evolution of interaction system design.


****Why Doodle?****
* Real Impact: Your commits will change how the world meets.
* Technical Stretch: We deal with "Time" problems most companies never encounter. It’s a masterclass in distributed logic.


 At Doodle, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual trust and respect, where equal employment opportunities (EEO) are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to age, race, color, disability, religion, gender, and sexual orientation. Diversity and inclusion are of utmost importance to us. We’re committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work and our products will be. We want to hear from you, so please don’t hesitate to apply!We look forward to receiving your full application.

***based and have the right to work in Germany.***

Founding Data Scientist
 



  





 Cubiq Recruitment \| Munich, Bavaria, Germany (On\-site)

 We are partnering with an early\-stage AI HealthTech company in Munich that is turning smartphones into screening devices \- measuring 60\+ biomarkers from face, voice, and eyes in under two minutes. No hardware. No friction. Just preventive healthcare in everyone's pocket.
 



  





 The company is seed\-backed, already generating meaningful ARR, and is now building its permanent internal team. After moving quickly with external support, they are hiring their first Founding Data Scientist to own the ML layer from day one.
 



  





 This is a rare opportunity to shape both the science and the product at a company with genuine ambition, strong funding, and a mission that matters.
 



  





 The Opportunity:
 


* As Founding Data Scientist, you will be the first dedicated data science hire and a core member of the founding team. You will own the machine learning stack end\-to\-end \- from research and development through to production deployment \- and directly shape how the product evolves.
* This is not a role for someone who wants to hand off to engineering. You will build, ship, and own real models that go in front of real users.



  





 For the right person, this role has a clear path to Head of Data Science as the team scales.
 



  





 What You Will Be Doing:
 


* You will design and deploy ML models that power customer\-facing features \- recommendation systems, biomarker estimation from video, audio, and text data, and signal processing across multimodal inputs.
* You will work on a unique digital twin dataset composed of voice recordings, face videos, eye images, digital biomarkers, blood biomarkers, and more \- one of the richest multimodal health datasets being built anywhere.
* You will contribute to the next generation of Doctor AI: a reasoning engine that drafts safe, evidence\-based medical protocols, and lay the groundwork for a conversational medical agent.
* You will work directly alongside the founding team and their ML Lead \- a former ML Lead at Machine Medicine, ex\-Lead Biostatistician at ICON, with publications in Nature and a successful FDA\-approved AI algorithm \- to set the technical direction for data science at the company.



  





 What They Are Looking For:
 


* The ideal person has strong statistical and ML foundations and has built and shipped real models in a production environment. You are comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity, and you treat "it's not my job" as a foreign concept.
* Strong Python skills are essential, alongside experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch), recommendation systems or signal processing, and a solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
* An MSc or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field is expected. Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare or banking is a strong advantage. Research experience and scientific publications are a genuine plus.
* Most importantly, you care about impact. You want to do work that matters.



  





 Useful Backgrounds:
 


* This could suit someone coming from a healthtech, digital health, or biomedical AI background, or from a high\-ownership startup or scaleup environment where pace and quality both matter.
* What matters most is that you are a builder \- someone who gets genuinely excited about deploying models that change how people interact with their own health.



  





 Why This Role Is Interesting:
 


* The mission is real. Prevention is broken \- 60% of people skip health screening because it is slow, invasive, or outdated. This company is fixing that with a product that is already in market, already generating revenue, and backed by unicorn founders and leading HealthTech investors.
* You will have direct access to the founders, meaningful founding\-level equity, significant autonomy, and the chance to build the ML infrastructure of a product that could reach billions of people.



  





 Package:
 


* Salary: €90,000 \- €130,000 depending on experience
* Equity: Meaningful founding\-level equity available
* Location: Munich city centre
* Working model: In\-office culture
* Start: As soon as possible



  





 Apply if you are a data scientist who wants to own the ML layer of something genuinely ambitious in AI HealthTech, please apply or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

title: Senior Data Scientist (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe is a leading mobile ad platform developing cutting\-edge advertising and monetization solutions that take its app partners’ business to the next level. Part of the applike group ecosystem, adjoe is home to an advanced tech stack, powerful financial backing from Bertelsmann, and a highly motivated workforce to be reckoned with.
   

  

**Meet Your Team: Programmatic Data Science**
 Did you know that in\-app ads are sold in a real\-time auction before they get rendered in thousands of mobile apps? Dozens of ad networks compete for every single view, choosing their best ad and deciding what price to bid in just a couple hundred milliseconds. We at adjoe have developed our own ad network that takes part in this competition, going against industry giants to present our own ads.
   

  

 In the competitive real\-time bidding landscape, the Programmatic Data Science team operates at a rapid pace, developing cutting\-edge algorithms, to create systems that outperform industry giants. Our approach is deeply rooted in rigorous research into user behavior, publisher and advertiser objectives, ensuring an optimal user experience. We are a fast\-moving team that rapidly translates theory into impactful solutions, using state\-of\-the\-art technologies and collaborating closely with product and business stakeholders.
   

  

**What You Will Do:**
* Architect and Refine Relevance Models: design and implement sophisticated targeting models that understand user preference within the dynamic ad tech ecosystem. Drive significant improvements in ad performance and user engagement through machine learning techniques.
* Explore Policy Optimization Strategies: Develop and optimize bidding policies using Bayesian method, reinforcement learning and other advanced optimization algorithms. Continuously refine these policies to maximize business KPI and adapt to the ever\-changing real\-time bidding landscape.
* Build and Deploy Meta\-Learning Frameworks: Create and implement meta\-models that learn from user interactions, enabling personalized ad experiences.
* Conduct rigorous A/B testing and experimentation: Validate your hypothesis and measure the impact of new features on key business metrics.
* Bridge Ideation and Production: Harden successful experiments into highly scalable solutions. You will take end\-to\-end ownership of your models within our modern ML stack (Python, Kubernetes on AWS, Airflow, MLFlow, Trino), balancing speed\-to\-market with robust engineering principles.
* Act as a Team Multiplier: Proactively share your specialized knowledge and engage in healthy architectural debates. You foster a collaborative environment where direct, constructive feedback pushes the entire team to excel.


**Who You Are:**
* You have 4\+ years of professional experience in the Data Science field working in AdTech, mobile gaming, e\-commerce or a similar industry.
* You have a track record of architecting and deploying machine learning solutions, with strong expertise in real\-time large scale recommender systems and neural networks.
* You are completely comfortable navigating a sophisticated, distributed engineering environment that produces massive amounts of data. You write excellent Python and SQL, with hands\-on experience integrating models into automated training and deployment pipelines.
* You possess a strong foundation in mathematical concepts and are skilled at translating complex algorithms into clear, concise explanations for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* You are highly pragmatic and solutions\-oriented. You know how to balance the pursuit of technical excellence with the need for velocity, recognizing when an 80% solution is exactly what the business needs to make an immediate impact.
* You value clear, direct, and kind communication. You are a strong team player who enjoys helping others and engages in productive technical discussions.


**Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions**
* Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skillset and achieve your career goals.
* Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.
* Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in\-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top\-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.
* Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.


 We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

 Mindrift connects specialists with project\-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems.

* Design end\-to\-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)
* Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches
* Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods
* Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers


**What We Look For**
 This opportunity is a good fit for Data Science specialists with an experience in python open to part\-time, non\-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:
   

  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on data science experience with proven business impact
* Portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real\-world problem\-solving
* Expert Python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels)
* Expert statistical analysis and machine learning \- deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications
* Expert with SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis
* Experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases)
* Understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows
* Knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
* Strong written English (C1\+)
