* Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, or related), or equivalent industry experience.
* 3\+ years of industry experience as an applied scientist, data scientist, or ML engineer with ownership of production ML models.
* Experience in applied science within a marketplace, supply chain, or growth domain.
* Solid knowledge of machine learning techniques such as classification, regression, embedding\-based approaches, and causal inference.
* Familiarity with modern LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, AWS Bedrock) and experience with agentic AI development practices and tools.
* Good knowledge of probability, statistics, and econometric methods, including experimental design, causal inference, and optimization.
* Experience with large\-scale distributed systems (Spark, Databricks, or similar).

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:

 Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country’s largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property \& Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva’s Ontario\-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long\-term stability.
 



 Every decision and investment remains anchored in long\-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.
 



**Are you driven by data, inspired by innovation, and eager to shape the future of insurance?** 




 Join a fast\-growing Canadian P\&C insurer where you'll play a pivotal role in advancing our Actuarial Services function. We're building on a solid foundation—powered by cutting\-edge technology, a robust enterprise data analytics team, and bold investments in AI. With this groundwork in place our talented team is now focused on scaling and refining our capabilities.
 



 We're looking for bright, analytical minds to help bring our strategy to life. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and want to explore Pricing, Underwriting, and Claims, we want to hear from you.
 



**Senior Data Scientist** 




 We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our growing team and build the next generation of predictive analytics solutions. In this role, you won’t just be crunching numbers, you’ll be using machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) models to transform raw data into powerful insights that drive our business forward.
 



 This is an opportunity to directly contribute to our core operations, working alongside a supportive team who are invested in your growth. If you have a passion for data and a desire to see your work make a tangible impact, this role is for you.
 



**What you'll do:** 



* ****Deliver value through data\-driven algorithms and models:****
 You will apply the right mix of ML and AI to solve high\-impact business problems. You’ll partner with stakeholders to select and defend the best model architecture and explainability approaches to balance performance, interpretability, and trade\-offs.
* ****Embed ML/AI into core business capabilities:****
 You will
 
 build deep expertise in P\&C insurance workflows and translate that knowledge into practical ML/AI\-powered analyses, decision tools, and visualizations that improve how work gets done.
* ****Partner with stakeholders to ensure adoption, value, and model integrity:****
 You’ll align with stakeholders on goals and success metrics, then pressure\-test solutions against real constraints to ensure they’re feasible and valuable. You will communicate your insights and recommendations with clarity and confidence to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* ****Invest in Your Future:****
 We're committed to your professional development. You'll engage in project\-specific research to continually grow your skills and have the unique opportunity to collaborate with our Claims and Finance departments.




**What You’ll Need to Succeed** 







* Master's or PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, CS, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Economics, or similar)
* 5\+ years building and deploying ML/AI models in production
* Strong hands\-on experience with both classical ML (GLMs, LightGBM, XGBoost etc ) and modern NLP (BERT, embeddings, LLMs, Hugging Face, RAG) for modelling both structured \& unstructured datasets(tabular, text, document and images)

* Experience with model governance, MLOps, performance monitoring.

 If you're ready to be a core part of our mission and make a tangible impact from day one, we want to hear from you.

title: Applied Scientist II
description:
**About Us**
 Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.
   

  

 Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring an Applied Scientist II to build and improve the machine learning and GenAI models that power our underwriting decisions. You will take ownership of high\-impact modeling problems end\-to\-end. This includes framing and data exploration through model design, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, directly influencing how we assess and price cyber risk.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with underwriters, product managers, and engineers to design robust pipelines, experiment with state\-of\-the\-art ML/GenAI techniques, and ship models that meaningfully move business metrics. Your work will turn complex insurance and security signals into reliable decisioning systems, helping Coalition write better business at scale while pushing the frontier of AI in underwriting.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build and advance our most sensitive and business\-critical ML and GenAI models that power underwriting decisions and risk selection.
* Drive and execute ML projects end\-to\-end: problem framing, data exploration, feature engineering, model design, prototyping, offline/online evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Design and implement ML pipelines for data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation, enabling rapid and reproducible experimentation.
* Apply state\-of\-the\-art ML and GenAI workflows (e.g., gradient\-boosted trees, deep learning, LLMs, prompt engineering, transfer learning) to improve underwriting accuracy, automation, and decision support.
* Own model quality and robustness by defining success metrics, running ablations and diagnostics, and iterating to outperform prior baselines.
* Survey and incorporate recent advances in ML/GenAI research into our core underwriting capabilities, balancing scientific rigor with practical constraints.
* Collaborate closely with underwriters, product, data, and engineering partners to clarify requirements, align on tradeoffs, and ensure models integrate cleanly into production workflows.
* Communicate methods and results clearly through documentation, presentations, and design reviews; share learnings and patterns that level up the broader team.
* Contribute to a culture of scientific and data excellence by bringing mature empathy, best practices, and lightweight processes to experimentation, code review, and model governance.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Ph.D. or MS in a quantitative or computational field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, Electrical Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of full\-time experience developing and deploying ML\- and data\-based solutions in production.
* Practical, hands\-on experience with supervised and unsupervised learning methods, including model selection, regularization, and calibration.
* Expertise in statistical analysis methods, especially regression analysis, statistical inference, and forecasting / time\-series methods.
* Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries (e.g., scikit\-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and SQL for working with large, messy datasets.
* Experience with experiment design and evaluation (e.g., A/B tests, offline metrics vs. online KPIs, guardrails) and with ensuring reproducible results.
* Comfortable and effective in ambiguous problem spaces; demonstrated ability to own and drive projects with minimal oversight and process.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain complex modeling choices and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Minimum 1\+ year of experience in insurance underwriting modeling (pricing, risk scoring, eligibility, or related applications).


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience with modern GenAI techniques relevant to underwriting (e.g., using LLMs for document understanding, unstructured\-to\-structured extraction, or underwriter copilot workflows).
* Familiarity with model governance in regulated environments, including documentation, validation, monitoring, and change management.
* Experience with ML orchestration and MLOps tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, SageMaker) for managing training, deployment, and monitoring at scale.
* Exposure to causal inference or uplift modeling for understanding the impact of underwriting or guideline changes.
* Experience working with cyber or P\&C insurance data (exposures, limits, deductibles, claims, external risk signals).

title: Economist / Data Scientist,  Économiste / Scientifique des données
description:
**Sommaire du poste**
 En tant qu'Économiste / Scientifique des données, vous serez au cœur de l'intelligence de marché chez JLR. Votre rôle consiste à transformer des données foncières brutes en indicateurs stratégiques pour décrypter le marché immobilier québécois. Entre la production agile d'études et le développement de modèles prédictifs, vous agirez comme une référence interne et externe. Vous veillerez à l’intégrité de nos données tout en positionnant JLR comme leader d’opinion à travers des analyses claires destinées à nos clients et aux acteurs de l’industrie.
   

  

**Vos futures tâches (60 % Économie / 40 % Science des données)**
* Prévision et analyse: Vous interprétez les indicateurs économiques, les tendances démographiques et les données du marché immobilier pour anticiper les cycles futurs. À l’aide de nos modèles de rédaction établis, vous produisez des études mensuelles et des dossiers thématiques clairs et prédictifs
* Analyses de données: Vous extrayez et analysez les données provenant de nos diverses sources pour en tirer des aperçus ( insights ) stratégiques. Votre rigueur permet d'identifier les opportunités émergentes et de répondre avec agilité aux demandes ponctuelles (clients, dossiers spéciaux ou requêtes de journalistes).
* Optimisation et intégrité des données : Vous veillez à la qualité et à la fiabilité de nos bases de données. Vous effectuez la manipulation, le nettoyage et la normalisation des sources de données afin de garantir une structure cohérente et rigoureuse pour l'ensemble de nos analyses.
* Développement de modèles : Vous participez à la construction et à l’affinement de modèles permettant de simuler des scénarios de marché et d’évaluer les risques. Vous transformez des données brutes retravaillées en outils de prévision robustes.
* Leadership: Communiquer efficacement les résultats analytiques par le biais de rapports écrits, de webinaires, de conférences et d'entrevues et vous positionner comme l'expert en la matière dans l'industrie.


**Vos futures tâches**
* Formation : Maîtrise en économie, science des données, statistiques ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe.
* Bilinguisme \- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais
* Langages de programmation: Maîtrise de Python, R, SQL ou d'autres langages de programmation pertinents.
* Analyse et visualisation des données: Expertise en exploration de données, en analyse statistique et en outils de visualisation de données (par exemple, Tableau)
* Apprentissage automatique: Solide base en algorithmes et techniques d'apprentissage automatique (par exemple, régression, classification, regroupement, analyse des séries chronologiques).
* Ingénierie des données: Expérience avec les pipelines de données, les processus ETL et les plateformes infonuagiques (par exemple, GCP, Azure).
* Expertise économique: Maîtrise des concepts économiques fondamentaux.
* Compétences en collecte et en analyse de données.
* Rigueur et synthèse: Capacité à traiter des données complexes pour produire des résultats précis dans des délais courts.
* Communication: Fortes compétences en communication écrite et verbale. Capacité à vulgariser des concepts complexes pour un public non technique.


**Ce qui vous distingue des autres**
* Expertise sectorielle : Expérience éprouvée en économie immobilière ou dans un domaine connexe.
* Connaissance du marché : Une compréhension approfondie des dynamiques spécifiques au marché immobilier québécois.
* Esprit analytique : Excellentes capacités d’analyse et une aptitude marquée pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.
* Aisance relationnelle : Solides compétences en communication et en présentation.
* Engagement : Une passion pour les analyses axées sur les données et une recherche constante de l'excellence.


**Synopsis of the Role**
 As an Economist / Data Scientist, you will be at the heart of JLR's market intelligence. Your role will consist of transforming raw property data into strategic indicators to decode the Quebec real estate market. Balancing the agile production of studies with the development of predictive models, you will serve as a key reference both internally and externally. You will ensure data integrity while positioning JLR as a thought leader through clear analyses tailored for our clients and industry stakeholders.
   

  

**What you’ll do (60% Economist / 40% Data Science)**
* Forecasting and Analysis: You interpret economic indicators, demographic trends, and real estate market data to anticipate future cycles. Using our established reporting templates, you will efficiently produce clear, predictive monthly studies and thematic reports.
* Data\-Driven Insights: You extract and analyze data from various sources to derive strategic insights. Your analytical rigor will help identify emerging opportunities and allow you to respond with agility to ad hoc requests (from clients, for special projects, or media inquiries).
* Data Optimization and Integrity: You ensure the quality and reliability of our databases. You perform data manipulation, cleaning, and normalization to guarantee a consistent and rigorous structure for all our analyses.
* Model Development: You participate in building and refining models to simulate market scenarios and assess risks. You transform processed raw data into robust forecasting tools.
* Thought Leadership: Effectively communicate analytical findings through written reports, webinars, conferences, and interviews, positioning yourself as a subject matter expert within the industry.


**What Experience You Need**
* Education: Master’s degree in Economics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Bilingualism: Proficiency in both French and English.
* Programming Languages: Mastery of Python, R, SQL, or other relevant programming languages.
* Data Analysis and Visualization: Expertise in data mining, statistical analysis, and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
* Machine Learning: Solid foundation in machine learning algorithms and techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time\-series analysis).
* Data Engineering: Experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, Azure).
* Economic Expertise: Mastery of fundamental economic concepts.
* Data Collection and Analysis: Advanced skills in data collection and analytical methodologies.
* Rigor and Synthesis: Ability to process complex data to produce accurate results within tight deadlines.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to simplify complex concepts for a non\-technical audience.


**What Could Set You Apart**
* Sector Expertise: Proven experience in real estate economics or a related field.
* Market Knowledge: A deep understanding of the specific dynamics of the Quebec real estate market.
* Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical skills and a strong aptitude for complex problem\-solving.
* Presentation Skills: Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Commitment: A passion for data\-driven insights and a commitment to excellence.

title: Join our Data Science & AI Talent Community at CommBank
description:
**What is the Talent Community?**
 At CommBank, we’re always looking for people who put customers first and want to use data and AI to solve meaningful problems at scale. Our recruitment is ongoing and never closes — you can join our Data Science \& AI Talent Community at any time, and we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities as they arise.
   

  

 Roles are typically based in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide or Perth, depending on the team, and sit within our Data Science \& AI practice across the Group. Opportunities commonly include Data Scientist, Senior Data Scientist, Chapter Lead/Senior Manager, and Principal Data Scientist roles.
   

  

 As part of our teams, you’ll build commercial, enterprise‑grade AI solutions that improve productivity, strengthen decision‑making and deliver better customer experiences — while ensuring AI is used responsibly, ethically and at scale for the benefit of customers and the broader Australian community.
   

  

**Global AI Leadership \& Partnerships**
 At CommBank, you’ll work at the forefront of applied AI through strategic partnerships with OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside deep collaboration with the global technology ecosystem. Our Seattle Tech Hub embeds our teams with world‑class technology partners to accelerate capability and deliver real‑world generative and agentic AI solutions at scale. This leadership has been recognised globally, with CommBank ranked \#4 worldwide in the 2025 Evident AI Index for AI maturity.
   

  

**Who We’re Looking For**
 At CommBank, our values of
 **Care, Courage and Commitment** 
 guide everything we do – for our customers, our communities and each other. Within Data Science \& AI, these values come to life through responsible use of data, ethical AI, and decisions that balance innovation with trust and impact.
   

  

 We’re building a community of Data Scientists who share these values – people who combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial thinking, leadership capability and purpose. Whether you’re actively looking for your next role or planning a future move, we’d love to hear from people who:
   

  

* Show care by putting customers and community at the heart of data‑driven solutions – acting with integrity, accountability and an ethical mindset focused on customer outcomes, colleagues and key stakeholders.
* Demonstrate courage through curiosity and sound judgement – excited by tackling new and complex business problems in AI, evolving existing products and capabilities, challenging assumptions and positively influencing senior stakeholders through evidence‑based insight. This includes a strong, curiosity‑led approach to questioning, validating and solving problems using mathematics, statistics and models, and feeling empowered to share thought leadership and problem‑solving ideas in a growing environment that addresses real‑world challenges impacting millions of customers across Australia.
* Live commitment by investing in continuous learning and craft excellence – bringing deep, hands‑on expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models (LLMs), with a proven track record of designing, building and delivering end‑to‑end AI capabilities for business stakeholders. This includes strong practical experience implementing Generative AI and agentic and multi‑agent systems, using modern frameworks and tooling such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph and the OpenAI Responses API, as well as applying a combination of commercial and technical AI models to deliver solutions that create strategic value.
* Thrive in collaborative environments – working closely with product, engineering and business teams, curious enough to solve real‑world problems, and collaborative in how you design, test and scale AI solutions across the organisation.
* Feel energised working autonomously and taking ownership – as a self‑motivated, driven leader of work who can effectively collaborate with, support and uplift teams of Data Scientists and AI specialists to deliver high‑quality, scalable outcomes.
* Connect purpose with impact – contributing to and leading transformational AI initiatives that improve customer outcomes, build trust, and support CommBank’s role in Australia’s long‑term financial wellbeing.


**What We Offer**
* Flexible opportunities with balance and impact – Enjoy hybrid working that supports both your career and lifestyle, while delivering work that genuinely matters.
* Deepen your expertise – Work with modern data and AI platforms, tools and frameworks, and tackle complex, high‑impact problems at enterprise scale.
* Grow your career – Join a strong data science community with clear technical and leadership pathways, mentoring opportunities, and the ability to move across domains and roles.
* Industry‑leading employee experiences, benefit packages and discounts
* An inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, supported by our dedicated Indigenous Careers Team. You’ll also have access to networks that celebrate diversity, foster belonging, and support accessibility requirements and workplace adjustments.


**How The Process Works**
* Apply anytime \- Apply using the link, tell us your availability and preferred locations.
* Talent Acquisition review \- If online assessments are successful, our recruitment team will review your experience and may connect with you to assess suitability for current and future Data Science opportunities at CommBank.
* Talent Community membership \- If successful, we’ll confirm your membership in our Talent Community for ongoing engagement for upcoming roles. As an active member, you can move quickly from expressing interest to interview, without needing to re‑apply.
* Get matched \- We’ll reach out when a suitable role opens.


 If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

title: Expressions of Interest - Graduate Quantitative Researcher 2027
description:
As our Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll develop, refine and implement statisitical models that directly impact and improve the global financial markets. As part of a team of expert researchers, you’ll leverage our large historical datasets and the latest technologies to develop innovative solutions that drive Optiver’s cutting\-edge trading strategies, fully immersing in the world of market making.
   

  

 If you have a critical mindset, a passion for quanititative problems and mathematical precision, you are the ideal candidate for this role. Join us and be a part of a dynamic team where you can make a meaningful impact.
   

  

*Please note, our formal applications for Graduate opportunities are currently closed. We are seeking expressions of interest for our 2026 campaign and would love to hear from you! Please complete this application to join our 'Talent Community' so that we can keep you up to date with suitable upcoming vacancies.*
**What You’ll Do**
 Your onboarding and training
   

  

 Kickstart your training in the Optiver Academy, our four\-week global training program in Amsterdam. Here you’ll learn from our dedicated in\-house education team and other industry experts through a series of lectures, coursework and collaborative project work.
   

  

 Following this, the comprehensive training program in Sydney will equip you with the knowledge needed to make an impact from the moment you join your research team. You’ll learn the intricacies of option theory and apply your knowledge to real\-world scenarios, developing models that contribute towards our trading success. We believe a realistic hands\-on experience is the best way to learn, and that is exactly what we provide.
   

  

 After joining one of our research teams, you’ll continue to optimise our innovative trading strategies, and gain a deeper insight into the different products and trading strategies within the team. Our education team will continue to provide training through a curated series of lectures over your first 12 months as a graduate researcher.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 From your first day on the team, you’ll have the autonomy and responsibility to make decisions that create an immediate impact. Every day will present you with new and interesting challenges to solve, and it’s up to you and your team to drive our success by ensuring that our quantitative models remain at the cutting\-edge of constantly evolving capital markets.
   

  

 Key responsibilities may include:
   

  

  

* Using statistical models and machine learning to develop innovative solutions that are foundational to Optiver’s trading strategies
* Leveraging big data technologies to analyse high\-frequency trading strategies, market microstructure and financial instruments to identify trading opportunities.
* Building stochastic models to determine the fair value of financial derivatives.
* Combining quantitative analysis and high\-performance implementation to ensure the efficiency and accuracy of pricing engines and libraries.
* Seeking continuous improvement in everything you do.


**Find your niche in research**
 We offer a range of opportunities in our research teams. During the training program, we will work with you to ensure that you’re placed in the most suitable role for you. Below are examples of the various roles available.
   

  

  

* Read Dom’s story to discover how he uses cutting\-edge statistical and machine learning algorithms to develop profitable live trading strategies in the Delta 1 team.
* Read Noah’s story to discover how he leverages large datasets to create underlying models that price our financial instruments in the Options Pricing team.
* Read Rob’s story to discover how he develops and tests hypotheses that drive improvements in the execution, speed and success of our trading systems, in the Performance Research team.


**What You’ll Get**
 You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high\-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

 In addition, you’ll receive:
   

  

  

* A performance\-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The opportunity to work alongside best\-in\-class professionals.
* Training, mentorship and personal development opportunities.
* Gym membership, plus weekly in\-house chair massages.
* Daily breakfast, lunch and an in\-house barista.
* Regular social events.


**Who You Are**
* Final year university student or recent graduate.
* An Australian or New Zealand Citizen, Australian Permanent Resident or able to provide evidence of full working rights.
* Studying a quantitative or technically focused degree, such as Maths, Statistics, Physics, Electrical / Mechatronic / Software Engineering, Computer Science, Applied / Quantitative Finance or Econometrics.
* Inquisitive and critical thinker, who enjoys creating innovative, new solutions.
* Have a passion for quantitative problems and working in collaborative, dynamic environments.
* Pragmatic and focused on outcomes, and can communicate technical concepts well.
* Enjoy utilising technology, programming or maths in your daily life to solve problems.
* Possess programming experience in any language (C, C\+\+, Python, Basic, JAVA, etc.).


**Diversity statement**
 Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion, and it is hardwired through every stage of our hiring process. We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities.
   

  

**Questions?** 
 Check out our internship and graduate FAQs or get in touch with the team at: careers@optiver.com.au.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About Brighte**
 Our mission is to make consumer energy resources (CER) affordable and accessible for everyone.
   

  

 Brighte is building the platform to enable and accelerate the energy transition by making it affordable, easy and less risky to buy and sell energy equipment.
   

  

 Our founder and CEO, Katherine McConnell, has been awarded Telstra Businesswoman of the year in 2020 as well as winning the Sustainability Crusader award at B\&T's 2023 Women Leading Tech Awards. She is a passionate and humble leader who has a human first approach to business.

 As Brighte'sData Engineer, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps our data reliable, scalable, and AI\-ready \- our ELT pipelines (Airflow \+ dbt), Snowflake Data Warehouse, and data architecture.
   

  

 You'll work closely with our Analytics Engineering and Analytics teams with one clear goal: high quality, traceable data that our business can trust and act on.
   

  

 If you love solving infrastructure challenges and want to shape the future of a modern data stack, this role is for you.

Fresh bread, protein bars, popcorn, fresh fruit, chocolate, soy crisps, cookies – you name it! We also offer a carefully curated collection of wines and beer on tap for those looking to unwind or enjoy a social moment.
* End\-of\-trip facilities. Cycle in to work, lock up your wheels and have a shower in our end\-of\-trip facilities, which come complete with towel service and hair dryers.

**Diversity and Inclusion**
 At Brighte, diversity isn’t just something we talk about, it’s something we live every day. We believe that innovation thrives when people feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work. Our inclusive culture is built on respect, collaboration, and the celebration of individuality.
   

  

 Named LinkedIn’s \#10 Top Australian Start Up (2021\), we know we wouldn’t be anywhere without our investors, who believe in our mission and the opportunities that lie ahead for a brighter future.
   

  

 Airtree Ventures, Grok Investments, Kim Jackson and Scott Farquhar’s Skip Capital, and Qualgro Partners all continue to support Brighte in making this dream a reality!

title: Senior Data Scientist - Security
description:
**Job Description**
**Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.**
 Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co\-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. But you have choice in where and how you work. That means if you want to do your thing in the office (if you're near one), at home or a bit of both, it's up to you.
   

  

**What You’d Be Doing In This Role**
 As Canva scales change continues to be part of our DNA. But we like to think that's all part of the fun. So this will give you the flavour of the type of things you'll be working on when you start, but this will likely evolve.
   

  

 You'll be a senior data scientist in an embedded analytics team within Canva's Security group. We solve hard data problems across security: building analytical models, maintaining backend services, and giving leadership the numbers they need to make decisions.
   

  

**Your Work Will Span Three Areas**
* Security metrics that drive decisions


 You'll own the metrics that tell Security leadership how we're actually doing. That means building and maintaining scorecards and KPIs across areas like vulnerability management, identity \& access, and compliance. You'll design data models, build dashboards, define OKRs with security leads, and translate what the data says into clear recommendations. The goal isn't just reporting — it's influencing where the team invests next.
   

  

* Evaluations and quality for AI\-powered services


 We're building AI\-powered services to solve security problems at scale. You'll own the evaluation framework — curating ground truth datasets, designing quality metrics, building human feedback loops, and iterating on classification approaches. You'll need to think like both a data scientist and a product owner here.
   

  

* Analytical solutions for real\-time security problems


 Security at Canva's scale generates problems that traditional data warehousing can't solve alone. Think streaming analytics over petabytes of logs, high\-concurrency queries for near\-real\-time threat detection, and monitoring access patterns across multiple cloud environments. You'll partner with security engineers and privacy teams to scope these problems, evaluate the right architectures, and build the analytical foundations to solve them.
   

  

**Day To Day, You'll Be**
* Analysing security datasets to find patterns, measure risk, and surface insights that change how teams prioritise
* Designing experiments, building statistical models, and stress\-testing assumptions
* Writing SQL, Python, and data models to turn raw security data into something stakeholders can act on
* Presenting findings to security leads, engineering leaders, and senior stakeholders
* Collaborating across security, privacy, compliance, and data platform teams
* Mentoring peer Data Scientists, running knowledge\-sharing sessions, and contributing reusable patterns and frameworks that raise the bar beyond your immediate team.


**You're probably a match if**
 You've got a track record of turning data into decisions — not just delivering dashboards, but actually changing what a team does next. Ideally, you've done this in a security or risk context, but strong analytical experience in other domains works too.
   

  

**You'll Need**
* Strong SQL and Python skills, and real experience with modern data stack tools like dbt and cloud data warehouses (not just "familiar with" — you've built and maintained production models)
* The ability to own a problem end\-to\-end: scoping what to measure, building the data models, validating the output, and communicating what it means to people who aren't technical
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks or quality metrics for ML/AI systems — things like ground truth curation, precision/recall analysis, and feedback loops
* Clear, concise communication skills — you'll be writing docs, presenting to leadership, and explaining complex findings in plain language
* Comfort working independently in a small team as a senior individual contributor — you'll need to self\-direct and proactively flag what matters


**It'd Be Great If You Also Have**
* Experience in the security domain — data classification, access control, vulnerability management, compliance frameworks, or threat detection
* Familiarity with LLMs in applied settings (prompt engineering, RAG, evaluation methodology)
* Experience with dimensional modelling, semantic layers, or building self\-serve analytics infrastructure
* Exposure to streaming or real\-time analytics architectures
* A background in maths/statistics and a degree in a STEM area
* Naturally share what you've learned — whether that's mentoring teammates, presenting at guild or specialty forums, or writing documentation that helps others level up.
* Experience at a tech company and familiarity with how modern data teams operate


**About The Team**
 At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design, and we’re looking for insightful data scientists who can help us make that happen.
   

  

 Our product has grown enormously in the last few years. We now have 100s of millions of users generating enormous quantities of data every single day. To help us fuel our future growth, we need to better understand our data \- this is where we need your help.
   

  

 We're looking for self\-motivated individuals who are curious about our product and our users, and who are excited to seek out valuable insights. We don’t want you to just be a resource that answers questions \- we want you to act as a genuine data partner with your team and the broader business. We have a LOT of data and need people who can use their skills to help us make the most of it!
   

  

 The Security Insights team is an agile team with a critical mission: scaling our data analytics capabilities to enhance our security posture. One of our key focuses is to measure, monitor, and work to reduce risks associated with permission and access to customer data. Your insights will inspire teams throughout Canva, helping us improve procedures and adopt the best tools to safeguard customer data.
   

  

**What's in it for you?**
 Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard \- and we do \- but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.
   

  

**Here's a Taste Of What's On Offer**
* Equity packages \- we want our success to be yours too
* Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents \& carers
* An annual Vibe \& Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup \& more
* Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

 As part of our teams, you’ll build commercial, enterprise‑grade AI solutions that improve productivity, strengthen decision‑making and deliver better customer experiences — while ensuring AI is used responsibly, ethically and at scale for the benefit of customers and the broader Australian community.
   

  

**Global AI Leadership \& Partnerships**
 At CommBank, you’ll work at the forefront of applied AI through strategic partnerships with OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside deep collaboration with the global technology ecosystem. Our Seattle Tech Hub embeds our teams with world‑class technology partners to accelerate capability and deliver real‑world generative and agentic AI solutions at scale. This leadership has been recognised globally, with CommBank ranked \#4 worldwide in the 2025 Evident AI Index for AI maturity.
   

  

**Who We’re Looking For**
 At CommBank, our values of
 **Care, Courage and Commitment** 
 guide everything we do – for our customers, our communities and each other. Within Data Science \& AI, these values come to life through responsible use of data, ethical AI, and decisions that balance innovation with trust and impact.
   

  

 We’re building a community of Data Scientists who share these values – people who combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial thinking, leadership capability and purpose. Whether you’re actively looking for your next role or planning a future move, we’d love to hear from people who:
   

  

* Show care by putting customers and community at the heart of data‑driven solutions – acting with integrity, accountability and an ethical mindset focused on customer outcomes, colleagues and key stakeholders.

* Feel energised working autonomously and taking ownership – as a self‑motivated, driven leader of work who can effectively collaborate with, support and uplift teams of Data Scientists and AI specialists to deliver high‑quality, scalable outcomes.

title: Head of Product - AI LAB
description:
**Description**
 Head of Product \- AI LAB \| Datacom
   

  

 Our Why
   

  

 Datacom works with organisations and communities across Australia and New Zealand to make a difference in people's lives and help organisations use the power of tech to make it all happen.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Head of Product** 
 for our
 **AI LAB** 
 who will work closely with the
 **Head of the AI LAB** 
 and who is equal parts product genius, builder, and relationship wrangler. This is not a role for someone who wants to make pretty widgets and get stuck in a triple diamond design mode. This is a senior, visible, and genuinely challenging role at the heart of one of ANZ's largest technology companies.
   

  

 You'll be the person who makes AI real at Datacom — for our clients, our teams, and our business. That means bringing people with you, building products that actually sell, and knowing enough about the technology to call a bad idea what it is.
   

  

 If you thrive in complexity, love people as much as you love technology, and want to build something that matters — read on.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Product \& Go\-To\-Market — Build Things That Actually Sell
   

  

 There's no shortage of AI Ideas at Datacom. What we need is someone who can take the best of those ideas and turn them into products that win in the market — products that our own teams want to put into projects for our external customers as well as for our internal work.
   

  

**Building Commercial AI Products**
* Lead the development of Datacom's AI product portfolio — from the first whiteboard session through to commercial launch and iteration
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to shape offerings that are genuinely differentiated — not just features dressed up as products
* Define clear value propositions that resonate with buyers — focused on outcomes, not technology for technology's sake
* Build the business case rigour that gives the organisation confidence to invest — and the commercial model that makes it worth investing in


**Winning in the Market**
* Deeply understand the ANZ AI market — where it is now, where it's going, and where Datacom has a genuine right to win
* Shape go\-to\-market strategies that are realistic, targeted, and built on customer insight rather than internal assumption
* Identify the verticals — Government, Health, Financial Services, Retail — where Datacom's AI products will land hardest and fastest
* Stay close to the competitive landscape and ensure Datacom's positioning is sharp, honest, and compelling


**Making Datacom Teams Love What You Build**
* Partner closely with our Teams to ensure AI products are easy to understand, easy to position, and easy to sell
* Create the collateral, the narratives, and the proof points that gives teams genuine confidence in the field
* Be accessible — the kind of product leader who shows up to client conversations, supports bids, and helps close deals
* Gather post\-sale and post\-launch feedback relentlessly — and use it to make things better


 AI Technology — Know Enough to Matter
   

  

 You don't need to be the best data scientist in the room. But you do need to be the person who knows when something is genuinely promising and when someone is selling you a dream. In this role, you'll be surrounded by people who live and breathe AI technology — and by senior stakeholders who will expect you to hold your own in every conversation.
   

  

**Technology Credibility**
* Maintain a deep enough understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, foundation models, and agentic systems to make sound technology judgements
* Know how to spot a bad idea — whether it's an overhyped vendor pitch, an architecture that won't scale, or an automation play that solves the wrong problem
* Engage authentically with Datacom's technical AI teams — earning their respect not through authority, but through genuine understanding and intellectual curiosity
* Be the person who asks the right questions in a technical discussion and knows what to do with the answers


**Agentic AI \& Automation**
* Understand the shift happening right now toward agentic AI — multi\-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI that doesn't just respond but acts
* Drive Datacom's capability in intelligent automation — including document processing, workflow automation, conversational AI, and process intelligence
* Oversee the integration of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks (AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI) into Datacom products and client solutions
* Ensure Datacom's AI technology choices are sound, scalable, secure, and commercially sensible


**Staying Current — For Real**
* This is a field that moves fast. Really fast. You'll need to invest the time to stay genuinely current — not just across headlines, but across the technology, the vendors, the research, and the use cases
* Be the person in the room who has already read the paper, tried the tool, and formed a view — not the one catching up
* Build a culture of continuous AI learning across Datacom — because your credibility as Head of AI LAB depends partly on the capability of the team and organisation around you


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Senior leadership experience in AI, technology, or a related field — with the scars to prove it
* Extensive Product Knowledge in a corporate or enterprise scaled environment \- it is fine to have come through an entrepreneurial pathway BUT we need you to have that enterprise product understanding and experience in tandem.
* A natural relationship builder — someone who can work a room, navigate resistance, and build trust across every level of a large organisation
* Real commercial instincts — you understand what makes a product succeed, how to take it to market, and what sales teams need to win
* Genuine technical credibility in AI — not necessarily the deepest technical expert, but someone who has done the work to understand the technology and keeps doing it
* Comfort presenting and influencing at General Manager, Executive, and Leader level — clear, confident, and able to simplify without dumbing down
* Experience in complex, matrixed organisations where you've had to lead through influence rather than authority
* A bias for action — someone who moves things forward, makes decisions with imperfect information, and learns fast


 Why Datacom?
   

  

 At Datacom we value our people and provide a collaborative environment that supports career development and growth.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Flexible \& hybrid working arrangements
* Competitive salary \+ company benefits
* A genuinely senior platform to shape AI across one of ANZ's largest tech companies
* The complexity, scale, and ambiguity that makes a role like this worth doing
* A diverse and inclusive culture where different perspectives are not just welcomed — they're needed
* Real career development and the support to keep growing

title: Data Scientist - Machine Learning
description:
**Who We Are** 




 We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.
 



  





 Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service\-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave\-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.
 



  





**What We'll Need** 




 This role contributes to Wingstop’s success by bridging data science and production engineering — deploying, optimizing, and scaling machine learning systems that power data\-driven decisions across the enterprise. The Data Scientist\-Machine Learning is responsible for taking models from development to production, ensuring they are robust, efficient, and maintainable.
 



  





 While data science work remains part of the role, the primary focus is on deployment pipelines, infrastructure management, and code optimization that enable the broader analytics organization to deliver impact at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Collaboration and Cross\-Functional Engagement:\- Work closely with stakeholders to understand business objectives and requirements.
* Partner with data scientists, analytics engineers, and platform teams to move models from experimentation into production\-ready systems.
* MLOps and Deployment Infrastructure:\- Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end ML pipelines for training, validation, deployment, and retraining.
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure) to support scalable ML workloads and reduce operational cost.
* Code Quality and Optimization:\- Write clean, efficient, reusable code for ML pipelines and data processes; enforce engineering best practices through code reviews and documentation.
* Profile and optimize inference latency, memory usage, and throughput for models serving real\-time or batch workloads.
* Automate testing, CI/CD workflows, and deployment processes to ensure reliable, repeatable model releases.
* Model Deployment, Monitoring, and Maintenance:\- Own the deployment of ML models into production environments, including containerization, versioning, and API development.
* Integrate ML models into existing business systems and data workflows, working closely with software and data engineering teams.
* Continuously tune and improve deployed models, tracking performance drift and triggering retraining as needed to maintain accuracy and reliability.
* Monitor and alert relevant teams to key metrics and KPI’s.
* Data Science Support and Insights:\- Support data science efforts occasionally including exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model prototyping where needed.
* Develop dashboards and monitoring tools in Power BI or Streamlit Apps or similar platforms to surface model health, data pipeline status, and key operational KPIs.



  





**What You'll Need** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related discipline).
* Cloud or ML engineering certification (e.g., SnowPro Advanced, AWS Certified ML Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer) preferred.
* At least 3 years of industry experience in ML engineering, software engineering, or a related role, with proven production ML deployment experience.Strong proficiency in Python; experience with software engineering practices including version control, testing, and code reviews.
* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake (including Snowpark) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Hands\-on experience with Python, Java, or Scala; demonstrated ability to write production\-grade, reusable code to automate ML pipelines and data workflows.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, or similar) for managing ML workflows.
* Experience with data and analytics tools (e.g., Snowflake, Profisee, SAP BW, Power BI, Tableau)



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with ML deployment on Snowflake
* Experience building and tuning time series forecasting or demand prediction models
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for ML systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, MLflow, or similar MLOps tools)

 You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

 You will partner closely with the AI Applications Engineer, Data Engineering, BI, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, secure, measurable solutions.  Celebrating 25 years of innovation, Sunlighten has grown from its Kansas City roots to establish a global footprint, including expansion into the UK. * **Own a real slice of the growth funnel.** Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end\-to\-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.
* **Move the metric, not just the backlog.** Run a high\-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. ------------------



Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty\-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.



Fanatics is looking for a Soccer Manager to own and develop our soccer trading and pricing proposition. This is a hands\-on role sitting at the intersection of pricing, product, Operations, and customer experience, with genuine ownership of an in\-house model that has significant growth potential. We're building smartly — and that means embracing AI and automation as core tools for how we operate and scale.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* Own the soccer pricing strategy across pre\-match and in\-play markets, with a focus on competitiveness, margin, and sustainability
* Take responsibility for the in\-house pricing model — understanding its strengths, identifying gaps, and working with internal stakeholders to develop and improve it
* Collaborate closely with the Risk and Trading Operations teams on line management, liability decisions, and market\-making during live events
* Monitor the competitive landscape and ensure General Sports is well\-positioned across key leagues and tournaments
* Champion a best\-in\-class 24/7 soccer experience — ensuring the product is reliable, competitive, and engaging at all times
* Lead the approach to key fixtures and events (domestic leagues, European competitions, international tournaments), ensuring these moments are executed to the highest standard
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer\-facing soccer product and work cross\-functionally to deliver them
* Explore how AI can be used to personalise and improve the customer experience — from market availability to smarter in\-play offerings
* Manage relationships with third\-party data feed providers, ensuring quality, reliability, and value for money
* Lead a team of 2\-3 trading/pricing analysts, providing day\-to\-day guidance, development support, and clear direction
* Foster a culture of efficiency and innovation within the team — championing the use of AI tools to remove repetitive workload and free up capacity for higher\-value decisions
* Act as a key point of contact for soccer across Trading, Risk, Product, and Commercial teams


**What We're Looking For**


* 3\-5 years of experience in soccer trading, pricing, or a closely related role within sports betting or a data/analytics\-driven sports business
* Solid understanding of soccer pricing methodology — pre\-match and in\-play — and the ability to take ownership of a model rather than simply use one
* Curiosity and comfort around AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to pricing, trading, and operational efficiency — you don't need to be a data scientist, but you should know how to work alongside one
* Experience working with third\-party data providers and an appreciation for what good data infrastructure looks like
* Commercially minded — you understand how pricing decisions connect to margin, volume, and business performance
* Strong communicator with the ability to work effectively across trading, risk, and product functions
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team members
* Comfortable operating across time zones and working with a distributed team


**Nice to Have**


* Experience contributing to or developing an in\-house pricing model
* Hands\-on experience working with AI/ML\-powered pricing or trading tools
* Familiarity with US sports betting markets or experience working in a multi\-market environment
* Background in scaling a small IP or trading team
